provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: recogniser damage, same word: target reads potentie tue miracula etiam, the 1862 layer reads pot ntise tuemir cula tiam; recogniser damage, same word: target reads fragili uictoriam, the 1862 layer reads fr gili uict riam; recogniser damage, same word: target reads contulisti concede, the 1862 layer reads contuhsti conc de; recogniser damage, same word: target reads beate, the 1862 layer reads be te; recogniser damage, same word: target reads tue natalicia colimus, the 1862 layer reads tu natalftia c imus; recogniser damage, same word: target reads exempla gradiamur, the 1862 layer reads ex mpla graaiamur; conclusion length: the 1862 prints the short printed cue where the 1962 writes the conclusion out. Corroboration: 1922 Mame, artifact PDF p. 920 (printed p. 42* of the Commune Sanctorum); read from the page's word bounding boxes, reflowed column by column; reading: qui inter cétera poténtize tuze miracula étiam in sexu fragili victoriam martyrii contulisti : concéde propitius; ut, qui beatze N. Martyris tue natalitia célimus, per ejus ad te exémpla gradiamur. Per Domiaum. Recorded limitation: Target reading settled on the CMAA facsimile page image at 450 dpi; the crops read are kept in .scratch/backfill/commons-2/work/img. Not checked: the 1862's own page images, which this repository holds only for printed pp. [31], [32], [37] and [52]-[56].
